topic: How a parcel reaches the door

beats.viewerQuestion: Why can the parcel not leave the warehouse yet?
beats.before: The parcel sits on the shelf with a blank label
beats.operation: The scanner beam crosses the blank label and finds no route
beats.after: The parcel needs a route before it can leave
beats.attentionAction: Only the blank label is lit while the shelf dims

handoff.change: The parcel moves under the printer to get its route

beats.viewerQuestion: What does the label tell the sorter?
beats.operation: The printer writes the lane number onto the label, and the label is pressed onto the parcel
beats.after: The parcel carries a label for lane 3
beats.attentionAction: The view closes in on the label so its lane number can be read

handoff.change: The labeled parcel leaves toward the sorter
